description: This file defines an abstract class BasicDisplayField in the namespace OrangeHRM\Core\Report\DisplayField. The class provides a base for display fields in reports, requiring subclasses to implement methods for getting entity alias and field name, and providing a method to generate a select part string for database queries.

classes.name: BasicDisplayField
classes.description: An abstract class serving as a base for report display fields, requiring implementation of getEntityAlias and getField methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Final constructor for the BasicDisplayField class; does nothing.

methods.name: getEntityAlias
methods.description: Abstract method that should return the alias of the entity/table.

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Abstract method that should return the field name.

methods.name: getSelectPart
methods.description: Returns the string combining entity alias and field for use in SQL select statements.
